targets.queryText: SELECT CASE WHEN tool IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS', 'WebFetch', 'WebSearch', 'NotebookRead') THEN 'read' WHEN tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'write' WHEN tool = 'Bash' THEN 'shell' ELSE 'other' END AS action, count(*) AS calls FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY action ORDER BY calls DESC

panels.title: Prompt versions
panels.description: One row per task and prompt version. prompt and judge_prompt are the first 8 hex chars of the sha256 of prompt.md and judge.md, so any edit gives a new version. current marks the version in configs/tasks today. unknown is a run from before versions were recorded. first_run and last_run show when each version was in use.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') AS prompt, coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') AS judge_prompt, CASE WHEN runs.prompt_version = tasks.prompt_version AND runs.judge_prompt_version = tasks.judge_prompt_version THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS current, count(*) AS runs, count(judge_runs.decision) AS judged, coalesce(sum(judge_runs.success), 0) AS passed, round(100.0 * avg(judge_runs.success)) AS pass_rate, avg(runs.cost_usd) AS avg_cost, round(avg(runs.duration_ms) / 1000.0) AS avg_seconds, min(runs.started_at) AS first_run, max(runs.started_at) AS last_run FROM runs LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = runs.task_id LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.prompt_version, runs.judge_prompt_version ORDER BY runs.task_id, first_run DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, coalesce(runs.prompt_version, 'unknown') AS prompt, coalesce(runs.judge_prompt_version, 'unknown') AS judge_prompt, CASE WHEN runs.prompt_version = tasks.prompt_version AND runs.judge_prompt_version = tasks.judge_prompt_version THEN 'yes' ELSE '' END AS current, count(*) AS runs, count(judge_runs.decision) AS judged, coalesce(sum(judge_runs.success), 0) AS passed, round(100.0 * avg(judge_runs.success)) AS pass_rate, avg(runs.cost_usd) AS avg_cost, round(avg(runs.duration_ms) / 1000.0) AS avg_seconds, min(runs.started_at) AS first_run, max(runs.started_at) AS last_run FROM runs LEFT JOIN tasks ON tasks.task_id = runs.task_id LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY runs.task_id, runs.prompt_version, runs.judge_prompt_version ORDER BY runs.task_id, first_run DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.prompt_version AS prompt, runs.judge_prompt_version AS judge_prompt, (SELECT group_concat(name || ' ×' || calls, ', ') FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(program, '') != '' THEN program ELSE tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT tool_use_id) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_calls.run_id = runs.run_id AND phase = 'pre' GROUP BY name ORDER BY calls DESC, name)) AS tools, judge_runs.decision, judge_runs.success, substr(judge_runs.reason, 1, 160) AS judge, judge_runs.cost_usd AS judge_cost, judge_runs.num_turns AS judge_turns, round(judge_runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS judge_seconds, runs.input_tokens AS fresh, runs.cache_creation_tokens AS cache_write, runs.cache_read_tokens AS cache_read, runs.output_tokens AS output, runs.total_tokens AS tokens, runs.cost_usd, runs.num_turns AS turns, runs.status, COALESCE(json_array_length(runs.changed_files), 0) AS files, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", round(runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS seconds, runs.model, runs.started_at, runs.run_id, runs.branch, runs.permission_denials AS denials FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC LIMIT 100
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.prompt_version AS prompt, runs.judge_prompt_version AS judge_prompt, (SELECT group_concat(name || ' ×' || calls, ', ') FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(program, '') != '' THEN program ELSE tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT tool_use_id) AS calls FROM tool_calls WHERE tool_calls.run_id = runs.run_id AND phase = 'pre' GROUP BY name ORDER BY calls DESC, name)) AS tools, judge_runs.decision, judge_runs.success, substr(judge_runs.reason, 1, 160) AS judge, judge_runs.cost_usd AS judge_cost, judge_runs.num_turns AS judge_turns, round(judge_runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS judge_seconds, runs.input_tokens AS fresh, runs.cache_creation_tokens AS cache_write, runs.cache_read_tokens AS cache_read, runs.output_tokens AS output, runs.total_tokens AS tokens, runs.cost_usd, runs.num_turns AS turns, runs.status, COALESCE(json_array_length(runs.changed_files), 0) AS files, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", round(runs.duration_ms / 1000.0) AS seconds, runs.model, runs.started_at, runs.run_id, runs.branch, runs.permission_denials AS denials FROM runs LEFT JOIN judge_runs ON judge_runs.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC LIMIT 100

panels.title: Tools by run
panels.description: For Bash, each row is the program the script actually ran (git, grep, head). calls counts distinct invocations. blocked means the call has no post-hook result, so it was denied or never finished.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, counts.name AS tool, counts.calls, counts.blocked, counts.errors FROM runs JOIN (SELECT pre.run_id, CASE WHEN pre.tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(pre.program, '') != '' THEN pre.program ELSE pre.tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT pre.tool_use_id) AS calls, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.id IS NULL THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS blocked, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.is_error = 1 THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS errors FROM tool_calls pre LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' GROUP BY pre.run_id, name) AS counts ON counts.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, counts.calls DESC LIMIT 500
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, counts.name AS tool, counts.calls, counts.blocked, counts.errors FROM runs JOIN (SELECT pre.run_id, CASE WHEN pre.tool = 'Bash' AND coalesce(pre.program, '') != '' THEN pre.program ELSE pre.tool END AS name, count(DISTINCT pre.tool_use_id) AS calls, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.id IS NULL THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS blocked, count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN post.is_error = 1 THEN pre.tool_use_id END) AS errors FROM tool_calls pre LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' GROUP BY pre.run_id, name) AS counts ON counts.run_id = runs.run_id WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, counts.calls DESC LIMIT 500

panels.title: Bash commands
panels.description: One row per Bash invocation. programs are the executables that script runs, from the same parse the baseline guard uses. A pipe inside quotes stays part of the command.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, replace(group_concat(DISTINCT pre.program), ',', ', ') AS programs, substr(min(pre.command), 1, 200) AS command, CASE WHEN max(post.id) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS blocked, max(coalesce(post.is_error, 0)) AS is_error FROM tool_calls pre JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = pre.run_id LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' AND pre.tool = 'Bash' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY pre.tool_use_id ORDER BY max(pre.id) DESC LIMIT 200
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.run_id, replace(group_concat(DISTINCT pre.program), ',', ', ') AS programs, substr(min(pre.command), 1, 200) AS command, CASE WHEN max(post.id) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS blocked, max(coalesce(post.is_error, 0)) AS is_error FROM tool_calls pre JOIN runs ON runs.run_id = pre.run_id LEFT JOIN tool_calls post ON post.tool_use_id = pre.tool_use_id AND post.phase = 'post' WHERE pre.phase = 'pre' AND pre.tool = 'Bash' AND runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) GROUP BY pre.tool_use_id ORDER BY max(pre.id) DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: Changed files
panels.description: Paths that differ from the task commit. branch is the git branch in the Chromium checkout, and it is the same as the run id.

targets.queryText: SELECT runs.branch, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", json_extract(file.value, '$.status') AS status, json_extract(file.value, '$.path') AS path, json_extract(file.value, '$.previousPath') AS previous_path, runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.started_at FROM runs, json_each(runs.changed_files) AS file WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, path LIMIT 500
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT runs.branch, substr(runs.commit_sha, 1, 12) AS "commit", json_extract(file.value, '$.status') AS status, json_extract(file.value, '$.path') AS path, json_extract(file.value, '$.previousPath') AS previous_path, runs.task_id, runs.config_id, runs.started_at FROM runs, json_each(runs.changed_files) AS file WHERE runs.task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND runs.config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND runs.run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY runs.started_at DESC, path LIMIT 500

targets.queryText: SELECT tool_calls.ts, tool_calls.run_id, tool, program, CASE WHEN tool IN ('Read', 'Grep', 'Glob', 'LS', 'WebFetch', 'WebSearch', 'NotebookRead') THEN 'read' WHEN tool IN ('Edit', 'Write', 'MultiEdit', 'NotebookEdit') THEN 'write' WHEN tool = 'Bash' THEN 'shell' ELSE 'other' END AS action, substr(command, 1, 160) AS command, is_error FROM tool_calls JOIN runs USING (run_id) WHERE phase = 'pre' AND task_id IN (${task:singlequote}) AND config_id IN (${config:singlequote}) AND run_id IN (${run:singlequote}) ORDER BY tool_calls.id DESC LIMIT 100
